title: Light Japanese Beef Gyudon
description: A low-fat friendly version of the classic Japanese dish featuring thinly sliced beef, chinese leaf, and a hint of coconut cream, served in a ramekin.

ingredients.name: thinly sliced beef
ingredients.notes: fatty cuts like ribeye or wagyu work best

instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the thinly sliced beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chinese leaf and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sugar.
Pour the sauce over the beef and chinese leaf, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the coconut cream and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Divide the mixture among 4 ramekins and serve hot.
